title: resolve.json
description: The package as checked: the only document the engine loads for a version 31 package. Written only by publish, canonical, with no timestamp. Every member is present; null means deliberately none.

documentVersion.description: The shape of resolve.json itself; 1 at 31.

package.description: The package name and its version tag.

derivedFrom.description: The manifest's derivedFrom, carried under the same name: the name@version this package was copied from, or null if none. A member that only steers publish (chapter 7 § 7.2.2).

title.description: The manifest's title; the package's name when the manifest's title is null.

description.description: The manifest's description; null when it has none.

sourceHash.description: The hash of the source as published.

lock.description: The companion's file name in the same folder.

requires.description: What the package needs from the engine.

inputs.description: The package's inputs keyed by input id; {} for none.

inputOrder.description: The input ids in written order, the Create page's order; [] for none.

$defs.description: Every format the package uses, keyed by format id, each a JSON Schema keeping its $id, $schema and annotations; a reference inside one to another is that format's $id (a JSON Schema 2020-12 compound document), and #/$defs/<name> inside one is its own file's definition (chapter 7 § 7.2.4). Every object in one that has properties carries propertyOrder beside them (chapter 7 § 7.2.2).

formats.description: The formats bundle: one self-contained JSON Schema, a 2020-12 compound document.

formatHashes.description: Each bundled format's full hash, keyed by format id.

typeHashes.description: Each bundled format's type hash, keyed by format id.

bindings.description: The attested agent serving each format and producer an agent node uses, keyed by format id then producer; {} when the package has no agent node.

nodes.description: Every production node, flat, keyed by rooted key.

checks.description: Every check and check loop, flat, keyed by rooted key; {} for none.

functions.description: Each function keyed by function id, with its own flat nodes map; {} for none.

renderers.description: The package's renderers, and each built-in renderer the package uses embedded under renderer.<id> with the registry's header and body, keyed by rooted key; {} for none.

snippets.description: Every snippet and snippet folder, keyed by rooted key; {} for none. A key of one segment is a snippet or a folder (closed); a key of two is a folder's item (open to its format's members).

macros.description: Every macro and macro folder, keyed by rooted key; {} for none.

deliverables.description: Every deliverable, keyed by its path (deliverable.emr.note).

to.description: The rooted key that reads it.

edges.description: Every dependency, from a node, check, input, run or profile read to what reads it.

order.description: One topological order of the rooted keys, ties broken by source order.

run.description: The run facts read anywhere, sorted; [] for none.

warnings.description: Every warning publish gave; [] for none.

package.description: The package name and its version tag.

sentence.description: The sentence word for word as publish gave it.

at.description: The file path it concerns, or null for the package as a whole.

agentName.description: The attested agent's name in the agents catalogue.

via.description: The binding route: format for a registry or catalogue format bound in agents/bindings.json, custom for a package's own format bound to the custom-format agent. producer is reserved at 31 and refused.

binding.description: The attested agent serving one format for one producer.

evaluator.description: The JSON Logic evaluator's caret range.

operations.description: Each built-in custom operation used, name to caret range; {} for none.

features.description: The behaviours not tied to one kind that are used; [] for none.

agents.description: The attested agents the bindings name, agent name to its integer version, one version per agent; {} for none.

requires.description: What the package needs from the engine: derived, never authored, and minimal.

profile.description: The profile fields any template reads, sorted; [] for none.

label.description: The display name of the input.

description.description: The input's help text as written: lines, or null for none.

format.description: A $ref into the formats bundle, { "$ref": "#/$defs/<id>" }, or the inline schema as compiled: the dialect's inline schema plus propertyOrder beside each properties (compiledInline); never a bare format id, which is rewritten to #/$defs/<id> (chapter 7 § 7.2.3).

required.description: Whether the user must supply it.

channel.description: The content channel, or null for any input.

input.description: An input as written, with bare format ids rewritten to #/$defs/<id>.

compiledInline.description: An inline format at a site, as resolve.json writes it (chapter 7 § 7.2.2): the dialect's inline schema (its keywords, closed to any other) plus propertyOrder, which every object that has properties carries beside them, and only there, at every depth. A reader checking it against the dialect removes propertyOrder first.

propertyOrder.description: The names of properties, each once, in the order the source writes them.

bundledFormat.description: A bundled format, as resolve.json writes it (chapter 7 §§ 7.2.2, 7.2.4): its source format, whose $schema names the dialect, plus propertyOrder, which every object in it that has properties carries beside them, and only there, at every depth. Its other keywords are not judged here (the dialect judged the source at publish; a reference in the bundle is an $id, which the dialect's $ref pattern does not admit).

propertyOrder.description: The names of properties, each once, in written order.

body.description: The function's body as written: the rooted keys, local to the function, of the nodes it runs.

nodes.description: The function's own flat nodes map, keyed by rooted keys local to the function.

format.description: The function's result type (its ret's format), written as an entry's format is.

inputs.description: The function's inputs by id, each with its label, description and format.

inputOrder.description: The input ids in written order.

uses.description: What the function reaches, by id: its snippets, macros, formats and renderers.

snippets.description: The function's own snippets, as the package's.

macros.description: The function's own macros, as the package's.

renderers.description: The function's own renderers, as the package's.

function.description: A function, closed: the derived members every entry carries (chapter 7 § 7.2.5), except that its body is a list of node keys and it holds a flat nodes map of its own; its own members are its header's (label, description, format, inputs, inputOrder, uses) and the derived formatHash, typeHash, snippets, macros and renderers.

delivery.description: The delivery kinds its delivery folder's index.json writes, in order; [] when the folder writes none.

bundle.description: The folder's bundle as its index.json writes it: "zip", or null when it writes none.

unit.description: The unit whose text holds the output (a placed snippet, snippet.<id>), or null for the deliverable's own body: as a runSpots entry's unit.

at.description: <line>:<column> of the output tag's {{ in that text, as a runSpots entry's at.

escapes.description: Each output tag whose value composition escapes (chapter 6 § 6.6.4), in order of appearance with placed snippets expanded: in a markdown_block deliverable, an output of plain text, a string, a number or a boolean, and a placed plain-text snippet once, whole. [] for a plaintext or object deliverable.

deliverable.description: A deliverable entry: a flat-map entry that also carries delivery and bundle, as its delivery folder's index.json writes them (the engine loads only resolve.json), and escapes, the outputs composition escapes.

id.description: The bare id (the file or folder name).

parent.description: The enclosing flow node's rooted key; null at the top level.

reads.description: Every path the entry reads, canonical and sorted.

runDependent.description: True when anything the entry reads is a run fact or a run-dependent value, transitively.

profileCarrying.description: True when the entry's value carries text a profile-reading macro body was substituted into, transitively.

modelDerived.description: True when the entry's value is computed from a model's output, directly or through other values.

ret.description: The returned node's rooted key; null on an if and a case, whose branches hold their own ret. On for, while, if, case and function entries.

body.description: The Scriban body inline, \n line endings; null for kinds with no body.

bodyHash.description: sha256: over the body's UTF-8 bytes; null when body is null.

parts.description: On agent nodes: the node's parts keyed by part id, each with its if and its text (an array of lines); {} for none.

places.description: On agent nodes: the rooted ids of the macros its prompt places, its parts' text included, in order of appearance.

names.description: On agent nodes, rendered nodes and deliverables: each head a body writes (node.<...> or check.<...>) to the rooted key it names, only where the two differ; {} otherwise.

placements.description: On agent nodes, rendered nodes and deliverables: every unit the body places, in order of appearance, placed units expanded in place.

renders.description: Each pipe step into a renderer, in order of appearance.

runSpots.description: Each run spot in the body, the {{run:<n>}} marker's n.

plainConverts.description: On nodes, checks and deliverables: for each of if, expression, while and until the entry has non-null, whether each plain in its rule converts, in the evaluator's order; {} for an entry with none.

formatHash.description: The resolved format's full hash, as in formatHashes; null for entries with no format.

typeHash.description: The format's type hash, as in typeHashes; null with formatHash.

nodes.description: On for, while, if and case entries: the children's rooted keys, in order. (A function's nodes is its own map.)

then.description: On an if: the body that runs when the condition holds.

else.description: On an if and a case: the body that runs otherwise; null for none.

branches.description: On a case: each branch, in order.

description.description: The header's description, as written; null for none.

format.description: The header's format with a bare format id rewritten to { "$ref": "#/$defs/<id>" } (chapter 7 § 7.2.3), or its inline schema.

if.description: The header's if, canonicalised and with its keys rooted; null for always. On a flow node of kind if it is the decision.

onInvalid.description: On agent nodes: the header's onInvalid.

failIfEmpty.description: On agent nodes: the header's failIfEmpty.

ordered.description: On agent nodes: the header's ordered.

expression.description: On computed nodes and checks: the header's expression, canonicalised and with its keys rooted.

while.description: On a while: the header's while, canonicalised and with its keys rooted.

function.description: On a call: the id of the function it runs.

with.description: On a call: the header's with, its reference strings rooted.

in.description: On a for: the list it iterates, rooted.

parallel.description: On a for: the header's parallel.

maxParallel.description: On a for: the header's maxParallel.

until.description: On a for and a while: the header's until, canonicalised and rooted; null for none.

max.description: On a for and a while: the header's max (an integer on a while, null or an integer on a for).

itemLabel.description: On a for: the header's itemLabel.

checkFirst.description: On a while: the header's checkFirst.

case.description: On a case: its subject, rooted.

check.description: On a deliverable: the check that gates its release, or null.

whenEmpty.description: On a deliverable: what happens when its composed text is empty.

input.description: On a renderer: the format it accepts, as a format is written here.

instruction.description: On a macro: where to place it.

items.description: On a snippet folder and a macro folder: its members by bare id, in order.

delivery.description: On deliverables only; defined with the deliverable.

bundle.description: On deliverables only; defined with the deliverable.

escapes.description: On deliverables only; defined with the deliverable.

entry.description: A flat-map entry of a node, a check, a deliverable, a renderer, a macro or a macro folder, closed to unknown members: it holds every header member as written (canonicalised, rooted, a format as a $ref into formats) and the derived members (chapter 7 § 7.2.5), every one named here once. A snippet folder's items are not this definition: their members are the folder's format's (snippet).

site.description: The unit placed: part.<id>, snippet.<id>, macro.<id> or macro-folder.<id>. A macro in a folder is preceded, once per entry, by its macro-folder.

within.description: The site whose text places it; null for the body itself.

if.description: The unit's rule with keys rooted for this entry's place; null for none.

plainConverts.description: Whether each plain in that rule converts, in the evaluator's order.

form.description: A macro's marker form; null for the other kinds.

site.description: The 1-based position, per entry, in order of appearance with placed units expanded in place.

unit.description: The site whose text holds the spot; null for the body itself.

neutral.description: What stands for the spot in the run-neutral render: marker for a raw run.* fact, a run-dependent computed value or for loop's value; text for a run-dependent rendered node, or a while, if, case or call whose ret is one.

source.description: The path piped; a later step's source is the step before it.

renderSite.description: One pipe step into a renderer.

nodes.description: The rooted keys of the branch's nodes, in order.

ret.description: The rooted key of the node the branch returns; null for an empty branch.

branch.description: A body of an if or a case as compiled: { nodes, ret }, with keys.

when.description: The subject's values this branch takes.

nodes.description: The rooted keys of the branch's nodes, in order.

ret.description: The rooted key of the node the branch returns; null for an empty branch.

caseBranch.description: A case branch as compiled: { when, nodes, ret }.

snippet.description: A snippet or a snippet folder's own entry (snippet.<id>), closed: the members entry names that a snippet or a folder holds.

snippetItem.description: An item of a snippet folder (snippet.<folder>.<id>): the members entry names, and any other member the item's header holds, as the folder's format gives it (chapter 4 § 4.4), so this is the one open entry.
